full_judgment: 14. Of course, the said facts does not attract the present case in hand; as because, this suit was in a very preliminary stage which was fixed for taking steps after filing of the written statement and thus it shows in the present suit that the same was very earlier stage. The Order VI, Rule-17 of the CPC provides that the amendment of pleadings of the parties can be allowed at any stage to prevent the controversy between the parties, if so the proposed amendment does not change the nature and character of the suit. In the case of Naiyum (Md) and others vs Rahima Khatun and others, reported in 42 DLR 523 a Division Bench of this Court by their judgment held that the proposed amendment will not at all change the fundamental character of the defence case. Thus, their Lordships held that in rejecting the application for amendment has caused error of law occasioning failure of justice. Such decision of this Court has attracted the present case in hand; as because, apart from the pleadings of the defendant, she by her amendment application narrated a facts as was behind the execution of the deed in question and in what stage she paid-up the money to her brothers, mother and also the bank wherefrom a loan amount was taken for establishment of their residential building on the land in question. And further that the deed in question has been being acted upon after its execution by creating separate khatian mutating the defendant's share, as she found by the said Heba-bil-Ewaj Deed in question and, as such, that facts has to be incorporated in her pleadings and also to be brought before the trial Court below for mitigate the real controversy arose between the parties.
